verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਨਮਤ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਦੀਜੀਐ ਦਹੇਜ ਘਨੋ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਸੁਤ ਆਗੈ ਬਿਆਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਪੁਨਿ ਲੀਜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise janamat ka(n)niaa dheejeeaai dhahej ghano taa ke sut aagai biaahai bahu pun leejeeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as in the marriage of daughter born in a house, much dowry is given. And when her sons are married, much dowry is received from their in-laws house;

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਦਾਮ ਲਾਈਅਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮ ਬਨਜ ਬਿਖੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਲਾਭ ਹੇਤ ਮਨਿ ਸਕੁਚ ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise dhaam laieeat piratham banaj bikhai paachhai laabh het man sakuch na keejeeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as one spends money from one's pocket at the time of commencement of a business and then to earn profit, one should not hesitate to ask enhanced price;

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਗਊ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੈ ਸਹੇਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੀਅਤ ਸਕਲ ਅਖਾਦ ਵਾ ਕੋ ਦੂਧ ਦੁਹਿ ਪੀਜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise guoo sevaa kai sahet pratipaaleeat sakal akhaadh vaa ko dhoodh dhuh peejeeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as a cow is reared with love and care, she is served fodder and other items not eaten by human beings, and she yields milk that is drunk.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਤਨ ਮਨ ਧਨ ਅਰਪ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਦਾਨ ਲੈ ਅਮਰ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਜੀਜੀਐ ॥੫੮੪॥
verses.translit_en: taise tan man dhan arap saran gur dheekhiaa dhaan lai amar sadh sadh jeejeeaai ||584||

en.bdb: Similarly, falling in the refuge of the True Guru, one surrenders all (body, mind and wealth) to Him. Then obtaining the incantation of Naam from the True Guru, one achieves emancipation and is freed from repeated deaths and births.  (584)
